hints.tr: Önce kimlik: giriş yoksa ne olursa olsun `401`.
hints.en: Identity first: with no login it is `401` whatever else.

hints.tr: `403` yerine `404`: yok ile yetkisiz dışarıdan aynı görünsün.
hints.en: `404` instead of `403`: missing and forbidden should look the same from outside.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def public_status(found, allowed, logged_in):
    if not logged_in:
        return 401
    if not found or not allowed:
        return 404
    return 200

print(public_status(True, True, False))
print(public_status(True, True, True))
print(public_status(True, False, True))
print(public_status(False, False, True))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def public_status(found, allowed, logged_in):
    if not logged_in:
        return 401
    if not found or not allowed:
        return 404
    return 200

print(public_status(True, True, False))
print(public_status(True, True, True))
print(public_status(True, False, True))
print(public_status(False, False, True))
```
